node_purpose: Run exactly one real Dell Q1 issuer-truth Specialist shadow through the existing Agent Server. The model may plan across turns and choose only the already-exposed S1 Evidence and S2 Finance reads, then submit one source-linked workpaper or an explicit typed stop.
input_scale_basis: The zero-provider replay of this same Q1 graph completed in three turns. Host request sizes were 14,503, 84,822 and 92,192 characters; model-visible projections were 12,643, 33,269 and 36,026 characters. A 160,000-character per-turn ceiling therefore leaves material headroom without silently trimming context.
required_outputs: one valid terminal Q1 Specialist workpaper or an explicit typed stop
a Dell issuer-truth thesis and mechanism linked to current Evidence and Finance references
material counterevidence, uncertainty and what-would-change conditions
typed open gaps when the approved local data plane cannot support a claim
schema_burden: Every turn must return exactly one member of the closed action union: request Evidence, request Finance, submit the workpaper, or stop. Runtime validation rejects unknown actions, malformed parameters, unissued references, wrong run identity and unsupported authority promotion before accepting a terminal state.
materiality_quality_risk: The main risk is a plausible Dell conclusion built from the wrong company, period, metric basis or a retrieval candidate that was never promoted to Evidence. The existing MCP and graph validators must reject those errors; a failure is preserved for review and cannot be relabeled as successful qualification.
comparable_run_evidence: A zero-network replay used the same Q1 graph and the real local MCP composition and reached specialist_submission_accepted in three turns. Its host request sizes were 14,503, 84,822 and 92,192 characters and its model-visible sizes were 12,643, 33,269 and 36,026 characters. The focused implementation suite passed 142 tests before this authority was issued.
reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro with thinking disabled, temperature 0.0 and one structured action per turn. The Specialist remains agentic across turns: it sees validated tool observations, decides whether more evidence or finance facts are needed, and chooses when to submit or stop.
cost_and_latency_estimate: Expected completion is three to five model turns. Using the official DeepSeek V4 Pro peak, no-cache rates and conservative character-to-token bounds, the expected planning estimate is at most about USD 0.35; the absolute eight-turn envelope is about USD 2.01. Actual provider usage is authoritative, cost does not truncate required Q1 work, each turn may take up to 240 seconds, and eight turns is an anomaly stop rather than a target.
